title: Mississippi unemployment edges up to 3.4%. Pontotoc County figures are due Tuesday

paragraphs.text: Mississippi’s unemployment rate rose from 3.3% in September to a preliminary 3.4% in October, according to federal figures released Friday. Pontotoc County’s October numbers are on a different schedule. The Mississippi Department of Employment Security expects to release its state and local report Tuesday, Nov. 24, at about 1 p.m.

The latest state report for Pontotoc County counted 11,869 residents in the September labor force. Of those, 11,465 were employed and 404 were unemployed. That put the county’s rate at 3.4%, up from 3.2% in August, when 380 residents were unemployed.

Compared with September a year earlier, Pontotoc County had 50 fewer unemployed residents and a smaller labor force. The September 2025 figures were 454 unemployed out of 12,359 people in the labor force, for a rate of 3.7%. The state tabulates workers by where they live.

The county’s September rate and the state’s October rate happen to round to the same number. They measure different months, and the federal statewide figure accounts for seasonal patterns. The county series is published without that adjustment.
